To whom it may concern:

1 am writing regarding order 12FGE93, which I placed on 16 A pril. When I received the
parcel, the trench coat was missing. The invoice included in the parcel did show that I
paid for this item, and the item was not listed as being on back order when I placed the

full amount shown on the invoice.

I had been planning to take this coat with me on a trip in just a few days, so please cancel
the item and issue a refund.
